baseline.assertion: Late fullscreen callback must preserve local keyboard focus

checks: Playback stays read-only; Tab leaves and Shift+Tab returns with visible focus
Delayed fullscreen frames preserve explicit local keyboard mode and return-button focus
Closed canvas hides local return action and forwards no keyboard input
Canvas preserves remote Tab/Escape; exit chord releases modifiers, moves focus and offers return; mobile hint fits
IPv6 typing feedback, incomplete save blocked with focus, repeated compression rejected, mapped IPv4 accepted

transport: intercepted API/WebSocket; actual Vue and keyboard events
limitations: Proves an existing scheduling race compatible with hosted failure; does not recover the historical CI event timeline.
No real remote host; API and WebSocket use synthetic fixtures.
